rules.statement: A company can be held liable for a loan even if there is no formal meeting to authorize the borrowing, as long as two directors sign the bond and the money is used for the company's purposes.
rules.supporting_quote: In these circumstances, I do not think that it was necessary to decide whether, in fact, a meeting had been held to authorize the 'loan and the exact time and place of the meeting. It could not be seriously contended that the money borrowed was not utilized for the purposes of the Company.

meta.parties: Soysa v. Jupiter Cigarette and Tobacco Co. Ltd
